properties.description: Built 2026-10-24 (inference.rs ReadsAs, intent_truth, intent_full, node_reading; reasoning.rs; report.rs; add_inference). A PREMISE_OF link carries `reads_as` (`intent` or `delivery`), written per premise by add_inference's `as_intent` and `as_delivery`. Unmarked, a premise of a step that concludes a Decision reads as intent and every other step by delivery. As intent: a Requirement by its status (accepted or met holds, proposed or deferred unknown, dropped fails), a Capability by the needs it SATISFIES, an Interface by the Decisions that govern it; the Decision the step concludes lends nothing (circular). A statement (statement_kind, taken as given) and every other type read as themselves. Every reader agrees: the step's verdict and premises (`reads_as` shown), the decision's chain, proof status, conclusion_does_not_follow, foundations, the what-if walk, reasoning_report (`held_on_the_owners_word`, `awaiting_the_owners_word`, never uncited; a held one is not unsupported) and loop_status (the same two counts, and "WHAT AWAITS THE OWNER'S WORD").
properties.name: A premise says whether it rests on its owner's intent or on its delivery; a design choice's step reads its needs as intent by default
